name: root_eventstep_preview
model_read_before:
status: ok
model: SarAdc
scope: root
token_estimate: 342
blocks: 
  interface: 
    Outport: 
      - id: blk_463 #y1
        Name: Code20
      - id: blk_464 #y2
        Name: CodeValid
      - id: blk_465 #y3
        Name: CodeMeta
  algorithm: 
    - id: blk_111
      Name: Calendar
      BlockType: "M-S-Function"
      derived_info: 
        expression: "[y1, y2] = M-S-Function()"
    - id: blk_1
      Name: Driver
      BlockType: Constant
      derived_info: 
        expression: "y1 = Value where Value=[P.input.offset_v;P.input.amplitude_v;P.input.frequency_hz;P.input.phase_rad]"
    - id: blk_105
      Name: EventStep
      BlockType: SubSystem
      derived_info: 
        control_ports: 
          u4: trigger
        expression: "[PublicCode, PublicValid, PublicMeta] = EventStep(SineCfg, Event, ActualTime) where SineCfg=blk_1.y1, Event=blk_111.y1, ActualTime=blk_450.y1"
    - id: blk_450
      Name: SystemTime
      BlockType: Clock
      derived_info: 
        expression: y1 = Clock()
connections: 
  - id: "blk_111.y1 -> blk_105.Event"
    signal_name: Calendar
  - id: "blk_1.y1 -> blk_105.SineCfg"
    signal_name: Driver
  - id: "blk_111.y2 -> blk_105.trigger"
  - id: "blk_450.y1 -> blk_105.ActualTime"
  - id: "blk_105.PublicCode -> blk_463.u1"
  - id: "blk_105.PublicValid -> blk_464.u1"
  - id: "blk_105.PublicMeta -> blk_465.u1"

block_type_descriptions: 
  SubSystem: Group blocks into subsystem for model hierarchy
  Clock: Output current simulation time
